headline.description: Exactly 'Which <category> is right for <audience>?', in sentence case, with nothing after the question mark (the page's own note says how long the quiz takes). <category> is the product category in lower case, never the company or a model name; <audience> names the people the ad speaks to by their situation or goal (2-5 words), never a bare 'people' or 'buyers'.

dek.description: One plain sentence under the headline, at most 20 words, on what the quiz does for the reader. No uncited number, no 'whether you're' opener, no list of three.

hero.description: The header's hero image -- one asset_id from facts_pack.assets (the featured model's own assets), a lifestyle or installation photo in preference to a product-on-white shot.

questions.description: One entry per facts_pack.quiz.rubric question, in rubric order. Never add, drop or reorder a question.

prompt.description: The rubric prompt rephrased in the page's voice: one short question ending in '?'.

options.description: The rubric's option labels for this question, copied verbatim, same count, same order. The scores stay in the rubric.

interstitials.description: One entry per facts_pack.quiz.rubric interstitial, in order. Each teaches one verified fact on the rubric's topic.

after.description: The rubric interstitial's question id, unchanged.

line.description: 1-2 short sentences, at most 25 words in all. A digit, price, measurement or trigger word needs claim_ids; otherwise no digit at all.

faq.description: 3-5 questions a buyer asks before choosing a model. Every answer that states a fact carries claim_ids.

answer.description: 2-4 sentences. Answer first, then the detail.

cta_text.description: The one CTA text, from allowed_cta_texts (it names the featured model). The renderer puts it on the featured model's result card.

cta_url.description: Exactly facts_pack.product.url -- the featured model's own page. The one cta_url on the page.
